note: What the source page is required to contain, section by section. The harness checks the coded page against this list before it checks anything else. Without it, dropping a section during design would produce a template that imports cleanly, renders without an error, and quietly loses part of the site: the fidelity score would still read 100%, because it compares the render to the page it was given. For a real job this file is written from the client's live page; here it describes the sample fixture.
